notes.title: Matcha Warriors - News!
notes.content:
[h1][b]NEWS![/b][/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36701334/90b8b4aed35da6df289c8cd04f550e296c86ba1d.png[/img]


The release date is coming and the work didn´t stoped! We worked hard last months to release the game on 2020 Q2. We are already running the beta tests and all the main content are finished!
Yesterday we updated some screenshots on the Steam page to reflect the last game changes.

To the next days we plan to show more info about the game, the main features, mechanics, a new trailer and the release date annoucement! (it is near!!)

Stay tuned here and follow us on [url=https://twitter.com/SideralCreation]twitter[/url] and [url=https://www.facebook.com/SideralCreations/]facebook[/url] pages!

[h2]Don't forget to Wishlist and share with your friends![/h2]
